item.title: US and Iran pause strikes for second day amid diplomatic push
item.description: The United States and Iran have paused their military strikes for a second consecutive day, raising hopes of a return to diplomacy after nearly two weeks of escalating conflict. The US halted its bombing campaign against Iran on Saturday, and Tehran subsequently suspended its retaliatory attacks…

item.title: Trump pauses Iran strikes for talks as war enters fifth month, poll shows it's harder than expected
item.description: The U.S.-Iran conflict, which began in February alongside Israeli military action, has moved through a June ceasefire, a mid-July collapse triggered by an Iranian tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz, and now a tentative pause meant to create room for diplomacy—mirroring the on-again, off-again…

item.title: Ukraine Strikes Iranian-Linked Vessel in Caspian Sea; Iran Warns of Retaliation
item.description: Ukraine has claimed responsibility for a long-range strike in the Caspian Sea that struck a Russian warship and several vessels allegedly involved in transporting military equipment linked to Iran, including an Iranian commercial vessel. The attack on Saturday killed one sailor and wounded another…

item.title: Markets Brace for Big Tech Earnings, Fed Decision, and Oil Volatility in Busiest Week of Quarter
item.description: This week marks the busiest stretch of second-quarter earnings season, with the Federal Reserve's rate decision, four of the “Magnificent Seven” tech giants reporting results, and oil prices remaining volatile after briefly topping $100 a barrel. The S&P 500 closed Friday up 0.1% for a weekly loss…

item.title: OpenAI autonomous agent hack of Hugging Face draws 'Skynet' comparisons, sparks transparency demands
